retro-sport-brush.summary: 适合街头、音乐、运动和轻复古主标题。强调连笔、速度与整体轮廓。

expressive-brush-script.summary: 适合独立刊物、潮流海报与更具动作感的短标题。

rough-marker-display.summary: 适合地下刊物、硬派标签和短锚点。应控制在少量单词内。

fashion-ligature-serif.summary: 适合高端封面、生活方式杂志、美妆与婚礼主标题。参考装饰性连字，但正式输出使用安全代理或独立 lettering。

editorial-high-contrast-serif.summary: 适合克制杂志、电影海报和典藏型主标题。

elegant-signature-script.summary: 适合婚礼、题签、姓名、落款和少量高端信息层，不适合长段正文。

cn-editorial-brush-title.summary: 粗细变化明确，适合东方海报、短题签和现代书写感标题。

cn-heroic-ink-brush.summary: 墨块重量大、飞白明显，适合武侠、动作、热血与强叙事海报。

cn-running-script-poetry.summary: 更轻、更连贯，适合生活方式、诗意封面和角落题签。

cn-folk-display-handwritten.summary: 带有街巷、店招与生活感，适合市井、餐饮与纪实封面。

cn-retro-print-editorial.summary: 旧报刊、铅字和打印机气质，适合档案、文学宣传画与复古栏目。

cn-scroll-calligraphy-heroic.summary: 大幅书法锚点与米色纸张关系明确，适合水墨、武侠与东方概念海报。

cn-scenic-brush-title.name_zh: 中文景观题签式手写标题
cn-scenic-brush-title.summary: 带有旅行海报、山海景观与节气题签感；字面醒目，但仍保留轻松、可读的手写节奏。

cn-letterpress-poetry.summary: 旧报刊、铅字、打印机油墨和文学栏目气质，适合档案、复古唱片页与旧刊封面。

typography_relation_reference_batches.title_zh: 文字 × 画面关系范式 · 第一批
typography_relation_reference_batches.notes: 关系范式抽取文字层级、落位、人物避让和生图/排版通道分离规则，不复制原图可读文字。

typography_relation_reference_batches.title_zh: 文字 × 画面关系 · 最后一批

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 日记手写覆盖安静风景
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 文字可以跨越风景或身体边缘，但不得覆盖人物眼睛、鼻梁与嘴部。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate a complete lifestyle image with calm negative space and organic foreground texture. Do not generate readable final copy.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Use one oversized handwritten sentence as the emotional anchor, then add two or three tiny editorial metadata rows in the margins.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 巨型马克笔覆盖抓拍人物
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 巨字允许包围人物或穿过背景，但脸部必须保持完整可读，箭头不得指向眼睛。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate a candid youth snapshot with strong foreground energy and enough background occupancy for later handwritten overlays. No readable text.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Overlay oversized irregular marker words around the body silhouette, keeping the face as a clean visual island.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 开阔风景中的花体 × 黑体混排
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 用自然负空间承载文字。避免让花体长尾笔穿过人物脸部或关键地景。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate an airy pastoral landscape with stable horizon and open negative space. Do not render final readable copy.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Mix one romantic script line, two bold sans keywords, and a small serif note. Use circles sparingly to bind hierarchy.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 浪漫电影片名覆盖记忆帧
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 片名可进入画面中心，但人物脸部与关系视线必须清晰，长卷曲装饰只穿过负空间。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate a warm, imperfect memory frame with cinematic blur. Keep readable text out of the base image.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Use an ornate film-title wordmark, tiny production labels, and a restrained bottom credit strip.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: Y2K 梦核花体 × UI 信息层
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 轨道线、按钮与光标不得覆盖主脸；标题应围绕主体漂浮。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate a soft digital dreamcore base with orbit-like space and interface-friendly negative areas. No final copy.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Add ornamental title lettering, a small UI button, orbit lines, cursor accents, and restrained micro labels.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 朱砂印底上的中文墨刷锚点
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 人物海报中让墨刷锚点占据独立负空间；不得压过脸颈与主动手。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate rice-paper or restrained editorial base with a dedicated empty title field. Do not render readable final calligraphy.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Place a 2–4 character original or verified-font calligraphy anchor over a vermilion square, with two small seal marks and one narrow metadata line.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 卷轴底图中的纵向武侠题字
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 书法块应与人物分区，不把密集墨块压进人脸。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate an aged scroll or ink-wash base with architectural traces and a dedicated title zone. No final readable calligraphy.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Use 2–4 bold Chinese characters with visible ink rhythm, one narrow signature column, and subtle archival metadata.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 复古铅字 × 纵向栏目网格
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 正文与栏目线应贴边或进入背景留白，不覆盖主脸。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate an aged-paper archival base with clear column margins and no readable text.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Use restrained Chinese serif text blocks, vertical category labels, numbers, and thin frame lines to build an editorial specimen surface.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 时尚高反差衬线大字封面
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 大字使用独立负空间，连字与装饰尾笔只允许进入轮廓外缘。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate a clean luxury editorial base with generous negative space and restrained contrast. No final logo or readable copy.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Use one oversized high-contrast serif word, one tiny specimen row, and minimal brand metadata.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 山海景观中的白字题签锚点
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 当画面有人物时，标题可覆盖海浪或天空，但不得穿过人物眼睛、鼻梁、嘴部与主动手。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate a complete coastal landscape or travel image with a readable central negative-space band. Allow one small symbolic motif integrated into the visual structure, but do not generate final readable copy.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Overlay one confident Chinese brush title in white across the central scenic band. A tiny icon may be integrated near one character while remaining secondary.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 江南夜景中的标题与微型叙事符号
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 符号与标题优先落在水面、天空和建筑暗部，不与人物脸部或高亮灯笼重叠。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate a calm Jiangnan canal at blue hour with lantern reflections and a clean atmospheric band for later titling. Do not generate readable final text.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Use a white handwritten Chinese title, a restrained red seal, and at most two miniature narrative motifs such as a sun disk or birds.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 极简景观中的角落题签与月亮呼应
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 题签必须收进负空间，不压住月亮轮廓、地平线转折或人物识别区域。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate a restrained landscape with a clear upper-corner negative-space pocket and one dominant celestial anchor. Do not render final text.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Use a compact Chinese brush title in the upper corner, sized as a poetic annotation rather than a billboard.

typography_relation_patterns.name_zh: 墨刷中文 × 红色衬线英文 × 人物轮廓冲突
typography_relation_patterns.face_safe_rule: 中文笔触可以压住肩部、头发边缘与留白，但必须完整避开眼睛、鼻梁、嘴部和面部识别轮廓。
typography_relation_patterns.generation_channel: Generate an expressive portrait base with a strong silhouette and large clean negative-space pockets around the face. Allow abstract ink energy, but never generate final readable copy.
typography_relation_patterns.layout_channel: Place oversized Chinese brush lettering around the silhouette, then thread a restrained red serif English word behind or between strokes. Maintain a protected face halo.
